task: Simplify development gates: change-scoped advisory mutation, every gate in pre-commit, slimmer skills
rules: pyproject.toml import-linter contracts and tests/test_architecture.py own the runtime package layers and inner effect ownership; they do not change. tests/test_integration_tool_boundaries.py keeps scripts/ and tests/ tooling out of the runtime package and keeps the integration lifecycle standard-library only. Development tooling never becomes a runtime dependency.

modules.responsibility: Change-scoped mutation testing: map changed lines to functions, run mutmut in a fresh per-run workspace exported from the staged tree, and report survivors.
modules.interface: python scripts/mutation.py [--base REV] [--keep] [--strict] [--max-children N] [FILE...]; exit 0 when the run completes (survivors reported) or nothing is mutable; nonzero on a tool, configuration or clean-test failure, or on survivors with --strict.
modules.layer: Development tooling, outside the runtime package.
allowed_dependencies: git and the repository venv's mutmut as subprocesses
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Owns subprocesses and one temporary workspace per run, removed afterwards unless --keep.

modules.responsibility: Resolve one integration run (installed k8s-infra skill, run tag, Secret-derived environment) and drive up, test, stop and the pre-commit gate on the shared stands.
modules.interface: python -m tests.integration.lifecycle {env,up,test,stop,gate}; armed when the k8s-infra skill is found; the gate adds an infra.py room preflight; tag precedence INFRA_RUN_TAG > main branch slot > .run-tag > mint.
modules.layer: Integration test tooling, outside the runtime package; runs before pytest and tests.env_isolation.
allowed_dependencies: k8s-infra helper scripts, uv, curl and git as subprocesses
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Owns subprocesses, tests/integration/.run-tag, the coco8 download and the child process environment.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers and adapter independence for the cveta2 package (import-linter).
No cveta2 runtime module imports tests or scripts; negative cases inject both imports.
tests/integration/lifecycle.py imports only the standard library; injected cveta2 and SDK imports must fail.

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest -n 0 tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Layer contracts kept; effect fixtures still fail.
Runtime modules import no tooling; lifecycle.py stays standard-library only; injected forbidden imports are reported.
Lifecycle arming, room preflight and tag rules; mutation diff mapping, workspace isolation, exit codes and reporting.

checks.command: uv run python scripts/mutation.py --base HEAD~0 <changed file> (weakened assertion) and on a clean tree
checks.expectation: A weakened test yields a reported survivor; a clean tree reports nothing to mutate; workspace removed.

checks.command: git commit (pre-commit runs uv run python -m tests.integration.lifecycle gate)
checks.expectation: The live gate runs at pre-commit, passes and stops its tag.
Documented commands, paths and links resolve.

documentation: .specify/memory/constitution.md, .specify/memory/engineering.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/README.md, .claude/skills/{commit,mutation-testing,running-integration-tests}; historical specs and plans are not rewritten.
